hero.title: Stash your money like a hamster stashes seeds.
hero.lead: Track what comes in and what goes out, set money aside in vaults and see where every real goes. No ads and no selling your data.
hero.note: Works in the browser and can be installed on your phone.

promises.label: What {{appName}} promises
promises.freeText: No paid plan to unlock anything.
promises.yoursText: Nobody else sees it, and we don't sell it.
promises.devicesText: Install it as an app, no store needed.

features.title: Everything you track, in one place.
features.intro: From your salary to a coffee, from the rent that repeats to the fridge in ten installments.
features.transactionsText: Income and expenses with categories, description search and period filters.
features.vaultsText: Set money aside for a goal and see how much is left.
features.budgetsText: One limit per category, and a heads-up before you go over.
features.recurringText: Rent is added by itself every month. An installment purchase shows up in each right month.
features.reportsText: Where the money went, by category and over time.
features.yoursText: Dark or light theme, Portuguese or English, and the app installed on your phone.

steps.title: Getting started takes two minutes.
steps.intro: No bank connection and no documents.
steps.accountText: With email and password, or by signing in with Google.
steps.balanceText: What you have today becomes the starting point.
steps.vaultText: Trip, savings, a gift: a name and, if you want, a goal.

privacy.title: Your data doesn't become ads.
privacy.intro: {{appName}} keeps only what you enter, to show it to you. Nobody else.
privacy.bankText: You enter what you want. No bank password, no Open Finance.
privacy.aiText: Your entries aren't sent to any company to analyze.
privacy.deleteText: Deleting your account erases your data right away, for real.

final.title: Start stashing today.
final.intro: Free, no ads, on your phone or computer.
